company: Z.AI Co., Ltd. (formerly Beijing Zhipu Huazhang Technology Co., Ltd.; trading/legal name now Knowledge Atlas Technology JSC Ltd.), brand Zhipu AI / Z.ai

ownership.quote: Formerly known as Zhipu AI outside China until 2025, it is China's first major LLM company to make initial public offering, on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in January 2026.

stage.quote: On 8 January 2026, Z.ai held its IPO on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange to become a listed company. It is considered to be China's first major LLM company that went through an IPO.
stage.note: Company (spun out of Tsinghua University in 2019) raised several private VC rounds from 2023-2024, then completed an IPO on HKEX (ticker 2513) on 8 Jan 2026, so current stage is public, not a private funding stage.

total_funding_usd.basis: Sum of two confirmed pre-IPO rounds reported by Bloomberg/CNBC/SCMP: ~2.5 billion yuan (~US$350M) in Oct 2023 and US$400M in May 2024. Earlier/smaller rounds and exact IPO net proceeds are not captured, so this is a floor, not a full total.
total_funding_usd.quote: In 2023, it raised 2.5 billion yuan (approx. 350 million in USD) from Alibaba Group and Tencent, along with Meituan, Ant Group, Xiaomi, and HongShan... In May 2024, the Saudi Arabian finance firm Prosperity7 Ventures, LLC participated in a US$400 million financing round for Zhipu AI with a valuation of approximately US$3 billion.

last_round.quote: On 8 January 2026, Z.ai held its IPO on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange to become a listed company... With a market capitalization of US$62 billion as of August 2026, it is the most valuable public AI pure play in China.

note: Zhipu AI (rebranded internationally as Z.ai in July 2025; Chinese legal name changed to Knowledge Atlas Technology in 2025) is a Tsinghua University spin-out founded in 2019, one of China's 'AI Tiger' LLM companies, and completed the first IPO among major Chinese LLM firms on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange (ticker 2513) on 8 January 2026, with market cap ~US$62B as of August 2026. It was added to the US Commerce Department's Entity List in January 2025. This card's product is Zhipu's 'Managed Agent' sandbox offering documented at docs.bigmodel.cn, a small part of the broader public company's business; revenue figures here (unknown) would refer to the whole company, not this specific product line.
